Registrations are now open for the 12th CASSINI Hackathon! 
27-29 November 2026

 

The 12th CASSINI Hackathon - EU Space for Peace and Resilience will take place from 27 - 29 November 2026. We will update the further details soon. No space experience needed - just choose a challenge, use EU space tech, and compete for cash prizes up to 9,000€ (1st: 5,000€, 2nd: 3,000€, 3rd: 1,000€) plus 6 months of mentoring. Be sure to review the Rules of Contest before applying. 

 

The Big Ideas Campaign
 

Registration is now open!
Join a series of webinars introducing the 12th CASSINI Hackathon theme, the tools and technologies available, and details about your local Hackathon. Simply navigate to the Big Ideas Campaign section , choose the webinars most relevant to you, and register. Then, join the webinars to get first-hand information on how to build the most relevant solution.
